value.rationale: The line-free locus is the distinguished nontrivial rational-point domain of the classical Cayley cubic, so exact finite-field counts and zetas are natural arithmetic invariants relevant to local factors in rational-point studies. The entire five-form family is classified, and the point-free split F3 case is a sharp meaningful existence boundary; this is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
